d:
A massive, anthropomorphic deep-sea diver species with a heavy, rusted iron diving suit as a body. The head is a singular, glowing amber eye peering through a reinforced glass viewport. The build is immense and hulking, featuring a large anchor as a weapon and barnacles encrusted across the metal plating. No hair, no ears, no tail, and four thick metal fingers per hand.
BODY COLOR: rusted iron grey
